name: Pentastory: Nessa's Dilemma
source:
Under pressure from her high-achieving parents, Nessa confesses that she's dating someone new. Now, they expect her to bring that person to dinner on Saturday, but there's just one problem: Nessa's single! Luckily, she has a close-knit group of friends to lean on. One of them will surely be willing to stand in as her date... if only she can dredge up the courage to ask them.

[From [url=https://amarvelous.itch.io/pentastory-nessas-dilemma]itch.io[/url]]
